evidence_boundaries: Mezlini et al. is an atomic-molecular theory calculation for boron hydride ions, not a direct fusion-edge measurement.
SPIRE reproduces numerical reference cases, but no public source-code location or independent experimental validation is established in the preprint.
The C-shaped-target Pareto front comes from two-dimensional Smilei runs at a fixed analysis time with idealized preplasma and one macro-particle realization per design.
The multimodal reconstruction model is trained and tested on a fixed-beta VPIC parameter grid without real FLARE diagnostics or sim-to-real validation.
GLOBE is evaluated on held-out WarpX trajectories from the same design distributions; its speedups exclude training and data-generation costs.
QUARZ benchmarks a quasi-static low-azimuthal-mode model; its non-uniform-grid gain is case-specific and the zero-touch-development statement is not sufficient correctness evidence.
No collision, PIC, optimization, neural-network, surrogate or wakefield calculation was reproduced locally.
